x_note: Sensor model of the closed-loop models (Sensors subsystem, Documents/Sim/ThucTeHoa.txt Mục 1). Chain per signal: true value -> + white noise -> Quantizer (resolution step) -> zero-order hold at the update period of the sensor signal. Two modes only: no seed = ideal sensor (chain bypassed, measured = true); a seed = quantization + update period + white noise of std sigma_noise (default one resolution step, 'accuracy +-1 step', self-chosen; v: 0.38 km/h measured in [S4]). Sources: [S1] Valeo torque/angle sensor, [S2] Bosch LWS steering wheel angle sensor datasheet (27/01/2026), [S3] Bosch MM5.10 datasheet (18/08/2020), [S4] Ragab, Givigi, Noureldin, arXiv:2501.00242. update_period: T_s, theta1, theta2_dot are read directly by the EPS ECU (1 ms); v, gamma, a_y come from the ESC over CAN (10 ms is an ASSUMPTION, the CAN cycle of ESC signals has no source yet; [S2] gives 10 ms for the steering angle sensor). Signal index i gives the seed of each noise source: seed_i = 10*run_seed + i.

seeds.x_note: Run seeds (5 digits, written seed_00000). Design/tuning seeds: Map 0-9999, PI 10000-19999, SMC 20000-29999, RL not assigned yet. Scoring seed of the standard test cases TC1-TC6: ONE seed, the same for every controller, counted downward from 99999 (99999, then 99998 ...). Source seed of every noise generator = 10*run_seed + signal index.

T_s.ref: [S1] 0.004 deg of torsion x 2.50 N.m/deg (K = 143.24 N.m/rad)

theta2_dot.ref: [S2] 4 deg/s (steering angle sensor; motor position sensors are finer, no source)

v.ref: [S4] 1 km/h integer CAN speed; sigma_noise = 0.38 km/h measured error of passive wheel speed sensors; ESC over CAN
